audit.why: 49.59% WR over 1232 games, even lane Qiyana dominates early; text already frames Vlad as a weak early laner who scales.
Spikes correctly identify levels 3-6 and first item as Qiyana's windows and Vlad's item scaling as his.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pool cooldown stated as 'fifteen-second invitation' — Sanguine Pool is 28s at rank 1, 16s only at max; the cooldowns field had no digits; the E-with-CC don't referenced a 'held stun' Vladimir does not have.
audit.why: Kit cooldowns are authoritative; Vlad has no stun, only Pool untargetability and slows.
audit.corrected: Real numbers used (W 28s->16s, untargetable 2s, Q 9s->4.6s); don't rewritten around Pool.
W 28s rank 1 / 16s max, 2s untargetable; Q down to 4.6s late.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Terrashape (element swap) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool (W): 28s at rank 1, 16s max, 2s untargetable — bait it before you spend your kill window, then all-in the long cooldown. - His Transfusion falls from 9s to 4.6s, so extended trades favor him late. - Your R (120s) has one job: the moment it all goes right.

edits.before: Grass-Q from stealth, E-ice the answer, auto, walk back into the hedge — terrain trades he experiences as ambush weather.
edits.after: Ice-Q the step-up and E onto the root — the burst lands before Transfusion ticks his health back, then exit to brush.

edits.before: Vladimir burns Sanguine Pool on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Vladimir burns Sanguine Pool on nothing — take the 28-second invitation.

edits.before: Your E sticks to the target it chose — dashing onto a held stun is a subpoena you served yourself.
edits.after: Your E sticks to the target it chose — dashing in while Sanguine Pool is up donates your combo to a puddle.

edits.before: E-ing in with no element loaded and his CC banked — Qiyana without terrain prep is a dagger doing improv.
edits.after: Terrashape is damage and escape in one 7s button — idle swaps leave the all-in unloaded when Pool goes down.

edits.before: Element-cycle the trades: E-ice-Q roots, auto, rock-Q the execute line. The lane is a terrain quiz.
edits.after: Element-cycle the trades and hold the kill window — his sustain has not out-ticked your burst yet.

edits.before: Supreme Display online — any fight near a wall is a stun lottery you rigged. Hug terrain like rent depends on it.
edits.after: Supreme Display online — bait Sanguine Pool first, then the wall-slam out-bursts anything he heals back.

edits.before: First item spike: the full element string deletes squishies. Force the brush-line fights.
edits.after: First item spike: the element string bursts through Transfusion faster than it can heal him.

edits.before: Late Qiyana flanks through her own R: shockwave the objective wall, string the stunned line, and vanish into grass.
edits.after: He scales, but you still win the duel: force Pool, then one-window burst him before the sustain matters.
